# Connector capability matrix

<!-- Generated by `dpdp-rights capabilities --format md`. Do not edit by hand: change the connector's
`capabilities` declaration and regenerate (CI checks this file is current). -->

What each connector can find, do and verify, and what the underlying service does not allow. Choose
connectors by capability: a store whose connector cannot delete individual items (logs, traces) is handled
by tokenisation, crypto-shredding and retention instead.

- **Finds data**: *Searches the store* finds a person's data even if nobody registered it with
  `track_artifact`; *Registered items only* acts on what lineage knows about.
- **Actions**: `delete`, `redact` (in place), `regenerate`, `crypto_shred` (make unreadable by destroying
  the key). A connector asked to redact something it can only delete deletes it.
- **Verifies**: how the result is checked after acting.

| Connector | Store | Finds data | Actions | Individual deletion | Verifies | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anthropic_platform` | Anthropic Files API uploads (the Messages API is stateless) | Registered items only: acts on files registered with track_artifact | delete | yes | Service confirms: delete call confirmed by the API | backend retention of API inputs and outputs follows Anthropic's terms |
| `aws_agentcore_identity` | AgentCore Identity token vault (per-user OAuth tokens) | Searches the store: one entry per principal | delete | no: access revoked instead | Service confirms: identity provider confirms sign-out | no API deletes one user's stored tokens; sessions are revoked at the identity provider instead |
| `aws_agentcore_memory` | AgentCore Memory short-term events and long-term records | Searches the store: ListSessions and ListEvents by actorId; ListMemoryRecords by namespace | delete | yes | Re-discovery: re-discovery returns nothing | none |
| `aws_bedrock_kb` | Bedrock Knowledge Bases | Registered items only: acts on documents registered with track_artifact | delete | yes | Action status only: deletion or ingestion job status | documents cannot be edited in place: redaction deletes the document, re-ingest it from source |
| `aws_cloudwatch_logs` | CloudWatch Logs, incl. Bedrock invocation logs, AgentCore Runtime logs and spans | Searches the store: Logs Insights query for tokens | crypto_shred, delete | no: whole stream only | Rescans for tokens and raw values: Logs Insights query for raw values within the lookback window | log events cannot be deleted individually; tokens become unreadable and age out with retention<br>Logs Insights indexing can lag by minutes<br>only the configured lookback window is searched |
| `aws_dynamodb` | DynamoDB items keyed by principal | Searches the store: Query on the partition key | delete | yes | Re-discovery: re-discovery returns nothing | items not keyed by principal are found only through lineage |
| `aws_s3_objects` | S3 objects, all versions | Searches the store: object prefix template per principal | delete | yes | Re-discovery: no versions or delete markers left | none |
| `aws_xray` | AWS X-Ray traces | Searches the store: trace summaries by the dpdp_principal annotation | crypto_shred | no | Rescans for tokens and raw values: scans segments for raw values | traces cannot be deleted; they expire after 30 days<br>only the lookback window is searched |
| `gcp_agent_engine_sessions` | Vertex AI Agent Engine Sessions | Searches the store: sessions by user_id | delete | yes | Re-discovery: re-discovery returns nothing | uses a v1beta1 API that may change |
| `gcp_bigquery` | BigQuery tables | Searches the store: principal column and STRPOS token search | delete, redact | yes | Re-discovery: re-discovery returns nothing | DML on recently streamed rows can fail until the streaming buffer flushes |
| `gcp_cloud_logging` | Google Cloud Logging | Searches the store: text search with entries.list | crypto_shred | no | Rescans for tokens and raw values: searches for raw values within the lookback window | log entries cannot be deleted individually; tokens become unreadable and age out with retention |
| `gcp_cloud_trace` | Google Cloud Trace | Searches the store: traces by the dpdp.principal label | crypto_shred | no | Rescans for tokens and raw values: scans span labels for raw values | spans cannot be deleted; they expire under the service's retention |
| `gcp_vertex_memory_bank` | Vertex AI Agent Engine Memory Bank | Searches the store: memories retrieved by user scope | delete | yes | Re-discovery: re-discovery returns nothing | uses a v1beta1 API that may change |
| `gcp_vertex_vector_search` | Vertex AI Vector Search | Registered items only: acts on datapoints registered with track_artifact | delete | yes | None: the service gives no read-back by content | datapoints cannot be edited: redaction removes the datapoint, re-ingest it from source |
| `jsonl_dataset` | JSONL eval, fine-tuning or batch files on disk, S3 or GCS | Searches the store: scans every row for tokens | crypto_shred, delete, redact | yes | Rescans for tokens and raw values: rescans rows for tokens and raw values | rewrites the whole file on each change |
| `langfuse` | Langfuse LLM traces | Searches the store: traces by userId | delete | yes | Re-discovery: re-discovery returns nothing | none |
| `log_file` | Local log files | Searches the store: scans lines for tokens | crypto_shred, delete | no | Rescans for tokens and raw values: scans for raw values | lines are not edited; tokens become unreadable when the key is destroyed |
| `openai_platform` | OpenAI stored responses, conversations, files and vector-store files | Registered items only: acts on objects registered by generate() or track_artifact | delete | yes | Service confirms: delete call confirmed by the API | abuse-monitoring retention (up to 30 days) is outside API control; use zero data retention where available |
| `redis_cache` | Redis response and semantic caches | Searches the store: per-principal key index maintained by track_cache_key | delete | yes | Re-discovery: index is empty | keys written without track_cache_key are not found |
| `sql_table` | Any SQL database: application tables, pgvector, summaries, Aurora, RDS, Cloud SQL, AlloyDB | Searches the store: principal column, and token search in the content column | crypto_shred, delete, redact, regenerate | yes | Rescans for tokens and raw values: searches for tokens and the raw values held in memory during the run | none |
